tooltip.singularityfusion.fusion_core.1: The heart of the structure: stands on a 3×3 floor of void casing, with 7 blocks of air above it.
tooltip.singularityfusion.fusion_core.2: Graviton pylons round it (up to 6 blocks away) hold the ingredients; the catalyst goes into the core.
tooltip.singularityfusion.fusion_core.3: Takes energy (RF/FE/OP) from any side: the black hole over it grows as it fills.
tooltip.singularityfusion.graviton_pylon: Holds one ingredient for a fusion core near it: use it with an item, with an empty hand to take it back.
Turns toward the singularity, and pours its item into it in a fusion.
tooltip.singularityfusion.void_casing.1: A fusion core's foundation (any of the three casings will do).
tooltip.singularityfusion.void_casing_ru: A fusion core's foundation, a rune pulsing in it.
tooltip.singularityfusion.void_casing_se: A fusion core's foundation, light running along its seams.
Endless energy: pushes all it can into every block beside it.
tooltip.singularityfusion.graviton_cryst: It bends gravity. Pylons and cores are built of it.
tooltip.singularityfusion.collapsed_star: A star crushed to a point, its light still turning round it.
tooltip.singularityfusion.event_horizon_: The heart of a black hole, held in the hand. Beyond chaos.
gui.singularityfusion.status.no_foundati: Needs a 3×3 void casing floor under it
gui.singularityfusion.status.blocked: The space above it is blocked
gui.singularityfusion.start.redstone: A redstone pulse into the core starts it too
gui.singularityfusion.unformed: The structure isn't whole: no singularity forms
